Stocks first-time user experience · Upstox

Designing onboarding for improved activation

Upstox opened 200,000+ accounts a month, but most new users never placed a first trade. I led a zero-to-one onboarding that nearly tripled 30-day activation.

  • Building a 0–1 feature
  • Delight
13% →37%30-day activation
62% →74%retention
21% →28%invested in NIFTY 50
Duration3 weeks · May – July 2024
My roleLed end to end, from insights and flows to visual design, with cross-functional teams and leadership
StatusLaunched
01The problem

Most new users signed up, then never made a first trade.

Upstox registers over 200,000 new accounts every month, but only a small share go on to place a first order. Many disengage because of a mix of practical and emotional barriers:

  • Not knowing the platformLimited understanding of how Upstox works.
  • Not knowing what to buyUncertainty about where to put a first investment.
  • Fear of the first stepApprehension about investing for the first time.
  • Not knowing they're protectedLittle awareness of investor protection measures.
25–27%

Activation rate: the share of users who make a first trade within 30 days of signing up. A large part of new users weren't engaging at all.

Reasons to believe

Every month, hundreds of thousands of accounts were opened, but only a fraction went on to buy equity in their first two months.

The objective: define an onboarding experience for stocks that activates and engages new users, driving more revenue and repeat orders.

02Who we designed for

Three kinds of first-time investors, three different needs.

  • Uninformed investor

    Completely new to investing, but willing to learn and get started.

    Help themHelp me learn, guide me, and support me in placing my first order.
  • Uncertain investor

    Understands the market, but finds it overwhelming to decide what to buy.

    Help themNarrow it down, educate me, and help me through the best options.
  • Confident investor

    Experienced, with clear preferences on what to invest in.

    Help themHelp me find a stock quickly and place my order.
03Research

We mapped how it feels to buy a first stock.

We broke the buying journey into four stages and mapped the emotions and questions at each one.

  1. 01Discover & shortlist
    🤩Excited😳Overwhelmed
    Which of these options is best suited for me?
  2. 02Analyse
    🤔Confused🧐Uncertain
    What do these terms mean? Is this good for the long term?
  3. 03Add money & pay
    😟Insecure🤨Curious
    Is it safe to add money to my wallet?
  4. 04After the order
    🤩Excited😟Insecure
    Was my order placed? If it failed, when is my money refunded?

What are competitors doing?

Key learning

Keep a straightforward, streamlined approach so users make their first investment quickly, confidently and without feeling overwhelmed.

  • Groww
  • Angel One
  • INDmoney
  • Dhan
04Guiding principles

Four principles shaped every decision.

  1. 01Make a strong first impressionTrustworthy, welcoming and intuitive, with appealing visual design.
  2. 02Help users decide fasterLimited, safer options with only the essential information and minimal steps.
  3. 03Celebrate success, support failureGo beyond the transaction: celebrate wins and guide users through problems.
  4. 04Bring credibilityBuild trust so users feel secure and informed on a new platform.

Also guiding us: Educate comprehensivelyBoost motivationInstil trustMind the tone

05The solution

A first trade in four calm steps.

  1. Discover
  2. →
  3. Decide
  4. →
  5. Pay
  6. →
  7. Celebrate
Discover

One screen that works for all three investors

A welcoming entry from the home screen leads to a single “Invest in stocks” screen, layered so each type of investor finds their own way in.

Decide

Two safe choices, not two thousand

We recommended only NIFTY 50 and Gold ETFs, the most secure and widely used starting points, with tags for fast scanning, “9.8k bought last week” social proof and a SEBI trust line. We chose them against three criteria:

  1. 01Low risk, high rewardA safe, successful first investment motivates users to stay.
  2. 02Cheap and diversifiedLow cost, high return and low volatility suit a first-time investor.
  3. 03Well knownA familiar name gives new users confidence.

Each option opens with a short 3–4 minute video and clear reasons to invest, so users decide with confidence.

Pay

Less noise, and a story about where your money goes

The order continues in the same bottom sheet to avoid context switching, and the order form was stripped of clutter and trivial features. Adding money uses a short animated video that tells the purchase story:

  1. 1Money moves instantly and safely to your wallet
  2. 2The wallet money buys the stock
  3. 3Shares land in your Demat account
  4. 4Everything is protected by SEBI
Celebrate

Celebrate the first win, then show what's next

A celebratory confirmation, an introduction to SIPs to turn new users into repeat investors, and guidance to their holdings and how to discover future investments.

06Impact

Users who saw the onboarding activated, stayed and invested more.

62%→74%

Higher retention

People who saw the FTUE were more likely to place another order in their first 30 days.

13%→37%

Improved activation

People who saw the FTUE were more likely to activate within 30 days.

21%→28%

Increased investment

People who saw the FTUE were more likely to invest in NIFTY 50 stocks.

07What's next

Where we'd take it next.

  • Scheduled ordersOne in four first orders fails because account opening is incomplete, and only half of those users order within 30 days.
  • Stock basketsCurated, well-known baskets that simplify choices and cut decision time.
  • PersonalisationTailor stock selection to each user's risk appetite, budget and diversification goals.

The 30-second version

I led a zero-to-one stocks onboarding at Upstox that nearly tripled 30-day activation.

The problem
200,000+ new accounts a month, but only 25–27% made a first trade within 30 days.
What I did
Mapped three investor types and the emotions of a first purchase, then designed one entry for all three: search, trending stocks and just two safe picks, a simplified order form, an animated money story, and a celebration with a SIP nudge.
The result
Activation 13% → 37%, retention 62% → 74%, and NIFTY 50 investment 21% → 28% for users who saw it.
Kritima Arora · Design Manager
